purpose: Test whether any H01 scientific conclusion depends on the unavoidable missing block rather than on the economic mechanism.
analysis_intersection: Exclude the documented block globally from every asset and every required H01 feed, including feeds that are locally present in that block. Do not impute or substitute.
eligible_matched_blocks: Every fully observed UTC day in the applicable development or holdout window, excluding the documented missing day and any day containing a gap in any required H01 feed or asset.
procedure: Run the frozen D2-D4 decision pipeline on the common-intersection dataset.
Remove each eligible matched UTC day globally, exactly one day at a time.
Rerun the exact same frozen pipeline for every deletion; do not select, tune or stop early.
Record every candidate block, every stage decision and every final decision.
Compare each deletion result with the common-intersection primary conclusion.
decision_rule: If any eligible matched-block deletion changes the final H01 conclusion, final H01 status is INCONCLUSIVE. Otherwise the primary conclusion is retained, subject to every other preregistered gate.
forbidden: using sensitivity to convert a failed primary gate into success
basis_for_non_defining_judgment: Pre-outcome H01 documents define a general funding/basis carry mechanism over a 24-month, multi-asset panel; no specific calendar day or June 2026 event defines the hypothesis.
